name: Ember Scroll Gallery
description: Dark scroll gallery where framed photos tumble through 3D rotation as you scroll, glowing when centered, over a giant blended name marquee with vignette, film grain and a frame counter.
contents: Vertical zigzag stack of image frames with captions and index labels
Large horizontal name marquee behind the images
Fixed frame counter, vignette, grain overlay and loading line
behavior: Each frame rotates in 3D and moves in depth, scrubbed by scroll
Frame in the center gets a color glow and updates the counter
Marquee slides horizontally with scroll using a blend mode
Loader line shows until images have loaded
editableByProps: Images, captions, alt text and marquee names
All colors, blend mode, vignette and marquee size
Frame size, ratio, radius, spacing and zigzag spread
3D rotation and depth intensity, toggles for glow, index labels and counter

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow color of the focused frame

needsCodeEdit.where: new Lenis() call inside the init function

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Vignette, grain, marquee, counter and loader are fixed to the viewport and cover the whole screen while mounted
Includes top and bottom margins (marginTopVh, marginBottomVh) that give the scroll range
Root draws its own background color and uses a system font stack
